record.question: The number of Indian-origin people who have been featured in the 'Time100 Next 2021' –
record.explanation: The five Indian-origin honorees were Rishi Sunak, Vijaya Gadde, Apoorva Mehta, Shikha Gupta and Rohan Pavuluri. Contemporary reporting separately mentions Indian activist Chandra Shekhar Aazad, rather than including him in that five-person count: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/five-indian-origin-persons-indian-activist-feature-in-time-magazines-list-of-100-emerging-leaders/articleshow/81090608.cms
